title: nageia discolor
intro: Nageia discolor, commonly known as the 'Yellow Podocarp', is a species of coniferous tree in the family Podocarpaceae. This plant is native to Indonesia and Malaysia, and its name is derived from the Latin words 'nagai' and 'discolor', referring to its unique yellowish-brown bark. The health benefits of Nageia discolor include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and lignans, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory activities.
